title: London City Hall — New Year’s Eve 2026 fireworks admission and zones

facts.fact: The event is dated 31 December 2026 to 1 January 2027; fireworks viewing-area admission requires a ticket and the official ticket seller is Ticketmaster.
facts.excerpt: You cannot attend the fireworks without a ticket. Those without tickets will not be allowed to enter the viewing areas.
facts.location: About the event; Key information gives start/end dates and How to buy names Ticketmaster

facts.fact: There are six ticketed areas; guests cannot move between them, so a group must select the same area and its numbered gate.
facts.excerpt: You cannot move between areas on the night. If you’re coming with friends, make sure you book tickets for the same viewing area.

facts.fact: The Green viewing area is behind the London Eye and accessed from the south side via Waterloo; other zones have distinct river-side/gate requirements.
facts.excerpt: Green viewing area tickets cover the area behind the London Eye.
facts.location: About the viewing areas > Green; following paragraph supplies Waterloo/Entrance 7

facts.fact: The Orange viewing area is the dedicated accessible area at Albert Embankment near St Thomas’ Hospital, with a partial side view, so access needs must be considered when booking.
facts.excerpt: If you have access needs you should select 'orange' when booking tickets.

facts.fact: The organizer warns against bringing young children; everyone needs a ticket regardless of age and under 16s must attend with an adult.
facts.excerpt: Everyone, whatever their age, must have a ticket to get in.
facts.location: Bringing children; preceding text covers suitability and adult accompaniment

facts.fact: Pedestrian bridge restrictions and major event-road closures affect arrival and departure; choose the intended side of the river and consult current Tf L planning.
facts.excerpt: Choose the side of the river you want to be on afterwards to get home more easily.
facts.location: Plan your journey; paragraph beginning Stations will be very busy, following the specific numbered gate guidance.

facts.fact: Availability is not established by this capture: the official page announces one sale batch and a later batch with a date still to be announced; no purchase or live-stock check was performed.
facts.excerpt: Second batch: keep checking this page for the exact release date.
